description: This source file defines classes and functions for writing summaries, events, and graph data to files for visualization in TensorBoard, specifically tailored for PyTorch models and training process. It includes classes FileWriter and SummaryWriter with methods to add various types of monitoring data such as scalars, images, histograms, graphs, embeddings, and more.

classes.name: FileWriter
classes.description: Handles writing protocol buffers for events, graphs, and onnx graphs to event files for TensorBoard consumption. Supports asynchronous logging, flushing, closing, and reopening.

classes.name: SummaryWriter
classes.description: High-level API for writing summaries, events, graphs, and embeddings to event files for visualization in TensorBoard. Supports addition of scalars, images, histograms, videos, audio, text, graphs, embeddings, PR curves, and custom scalars.
